title: Virtual reality based cognitive behavioral therapy for paranoia: Effects on mental states and the dynamics among them
limitations: - Items were rated on 7-point Likert scales, limiting variation; - Conservative permutation tests used with limited group sizes, limiting statistical power; - No correction for multiple testing; - Baseline difference in one association without explanation; - Data assumed missing at random, not imputed.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether code or data are available. The authors mention that data were analyzed under the assumption of missing at random, which may affect the validity of the network analyses. The paper does not mention any preregistration.
